metadata.question: In 2023, was there over 160,000 hectares of fires burning in Quebec?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use MODIS or VIIRS burned area products for 2023 - Focus on Quebec province boundaries - Date range: January 1, 2023 to December 31, 2023 - MODIS MCD64A1 (500m burned area product) is ideal for this 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed - burned area products already processed - Use the BurnDate band to identify pixels burned in 2023 - Filter out unburned pixels (BurnDate = 0) 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero (B): Calculation succeeds, area < 160,000 hectares - Yes (A): Calculation succeeds, area >= 160,000 hectares - C1: No images in collection for Quebec in 2023 - C2: After filtering burned pixels, count = 0 (no fires detected) - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN or invalid value 4. Area calculation: - Count burned pixels, multiply by pixel area (500m × 500m = 250,000 m² = 25 hectares) - Convert to hectares for comparison ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Quebec boundary const quebec = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level1') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Canada')) .filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM1_NAME', 'Quebec')) .geometry(); // 2. Load MODIS Burned Area product for 2023 const burnedArea = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MCD64A1') .filterDate('2023-01-01', '2023-12-31') .filterBounds(quebec) .select('BurnDate'); // Check if collection is empty const collectionSize = burnedArea.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Collection size: ${collectionSize} images`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log('No burned area data for Quebec in 2023.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Create composite of all burned areas in 2023 // BurnDate > 0 indicates burned pixel (day of year when burned) const burned2023 = burnedArea.map(function(img) { return img.gt(0); }).sum().gt(0); // 4. Count burned pixels const pixelCount = burned2023.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: quebec, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('BurnDate'); const count = pixelCount.getInfo(); if (count === null || count === undefined) { console.log('Calculation failed - no valid result.'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (count === 0) { console.log('No burned pixels detected in Quebec for 2023.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 5. Calculate area in hectares // Each MODIS pixel = 500m x 500m = 250,000 m² = 25 hectares const areaHectares = count * 25; console.log(`Burned pixels: ${count}`); console.log(`Total burned area: ${areaHectares.toFixed(0)} hectares`); console.log(`Threshold: 160,000 hectares`); // 6. Final answer if (areaHectares >= 160000) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
